mappings.assertion: TestNormalizeAgentToolsMode maps the empty mode to skip and accepts auto, skip and force through the AgentToolsMode constants; TestConfigureAgentToolsEmptyModeSkipsWriting, TestConfigureAgentToolsAutoWritesWhenMissing, TestConfigureAgentToolsAutoKeepsExistingFile and TestConfigureAgentToolsForceBacksUpExistingFile run Configure through each mode.

TestPackageInstallCommandBuildsCommandForEveryPackageManager builds the exact command and environment for each of the nine PackageManager values; TestPackageInstallCommandKeepsManagerPreferenceOrder checks the candidate order; TestPackageNameForResolvesEveryManagerAndFallsBackForUnknownOnes covers the explicit-identifier, Windows-refusal and Unix plain-name fallback for every manager and an unknown manager; TestPackageInstallCommandSkipsManagerWithoutAKnownPackage and TestPackageInstallUsesWingetIdentifier keep the package fallback.

TestConfigureRejectsInvalidAgentToolsModeBeforeWriting and TestNormalizeAgentToolsMode refuse invalid, differently cased and padded modes with the unchanged message before any file is written; TestPackageInstallCommandRequiresKnownPackageManager, TestPackageInstallCommandListsEveryCheckedManagerWhenNoneIsPresent and the unknown-manager case of TestPackageNameForResolvesEveryManagerAndFallsBackForUnknownOnes keep unknown input on the existing fallback and error paths.

TestOracleA2ToolchainConfigure, TestOracleA2ToolchainInstall, TestOracleA2ToolchainList and TestOracleA2ToolchainDoctor run the toolchain commands live against unchanged goldens, fixtures, twins and PROVENANCE, together with the remaining oracles.
TestK4ImportDirectionGuard and TestS1SizeGuard run under make lint: the change adds no import edge, package or size offender.
